name: ENGL 4600W
title: Advanced Study: Seminars in Literature
description: Intensive study of various limited topics, such as a particular literary theme, form, or movement, to be announced from semester to semester. Small classes with an emphasis on writing. May be repeated for credit.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; at least 12 credits of 2000-level or above English courses or consent of instructor; open to juniors or higher.
